name: Ghost Shift
tagline: Run six restaurants out of one kitchen without losing your mind.
positioning: Ghost Shift consolidates every delivery platform, virtual brand, and prep ticket into one rail so owner-operators stop babysitting a wall of tablets.

hero.h1: One kitchen. Six brands. Zero tablet Jenga.
hero.sub: Ghost Shift pulls every DoorDash, Uber Eats, and Grubhub ticket onto a single rail, syncs your menus everywhere at once, and tells your line what to fire first. The tablet mountain is over.

features.title: One rail, every platform
features.description: Every order from every delivery app lands on a single kitchen screen, sorted by fire time. Retire the six-tablet chime concert nobody misses.

features.title: 86 it once, everywhere
features.description: Out of short rib? Kill it on one screen and it vanishes across all your brands and platforms before the next order sneaks in.

features.title: Fire-order routing
features.description: We time tickets by station and cook duration so fries and pho hit the bag hot at the same second, not five minutes apart.

features.title: Clone a brand by lunch
features.description: Spin up a new virtual concept from your existing menu, publish it to every platform, and start taking orders the same afternoon.

features.title: Per-order margin, live
features.description: See exactly what each ticket nets after commissions, packaging, and comps. Find the item quietly losing you money.

features.title: Chargeback comeback
features.description: Auto-collect prep photos and timestamps so you actually win the 'missing item' disputes instead of eating them.

testimonials.quote: We were running four brands off four tablets and a prayer. Ghost Shift put it all on one screen and my ticket times dropped by a third in week one. My cooks stopped yelling at me.
testimonials.name: Marcus Deng

testimonials.quote: The margin view was rude. It told me my best-selling wrap was losing me sixty cents a pop after commissions. Killed it, launched a bowl, and now we're actually profitable.
testimonials.name: Priya Nakamura

testimonials.quote: I cloned a new late-night brand on my phone during a slow Tuesday and it took its first order two hours later. Felt illegal. It is not illegal.
testimonials.name: Danny Ruiz

pricing.blurb: For the one-kitchen operator running a couple of brands.
For multi-brand shops that need timing and margin muscle.
For multi-location operators and franchise groups.

homepage.footerBlurb: Ghost Shift is the operating system for ghost kitchens. Fewer tablets, faster tickets, real margins. Built by people who've expedited a Friday rush.
